English Wizard.question: ১) Though he was weak, he went to school. (Make it simple)
English Wizard.option1: ক) He was weak and he went to school.
English Wizard.option2: খ) Since his being weak, he went to school.
English Wizard.option3: গ) Despite his being weak, he went to school.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Despite of his being weak, he went to school.
English Wizard.exp:
Complex : Though he was weak, he went to school.
Simple : Despite / In spite of + his + being weak, he went to school.
Or, Despite / In spite of + his + weakness (weak কে noun-এ রূপান্তরিত করে), he went to school.
ব্যাখ্যা: নিয়ম অনুযায়ী though/ although-এর পরিবর্তে despite / inspite of ব্যবহৃত হয়েছে + প্রদত্ত clause-এর subject he-এর possessive his ব্যবহৃত হয়েছে + তার পরে ব্যবহৃত verb was-এর পরিবর্তে being ব্যাবহৃত হয়েছে + প্রদত্ত sentence -এর বাকি অংশ অপরিবর্তিত অবস্থায় বসেছে।

English Wizard.question: ২) Find out the opposite of “Nimble”.
English Wizard.option1: ক) Dexterous
English Wizard.option2: খ) Adroit
English Wizard.option3: গ) Fatuous
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Agile
English Wizard.exp:
Nimble : Quick and light in movement or action; agile.

Synonyms
lithe, sprightly, acrobatic, light-footed, nimble-footed, light, light on one's feet, fleet-footed, spry, lively, active, quick, quick-moving, graceful, supple, limber, lissom, flexible, skilful, deft, dexterous, adroit

Antonyms for nimble

airheaded, birdbrained, boneheaded, dumb, dunderheaded, empty-headed, fatuous, vacuous, weak-minded, witless
Source: Merriam-Webster

English Wizard.question: ৩) Very few metals are as costly as gold. (Make it Comparative)
English Wizard.option1: ক) Gold is more costlier than most other metals.
English Wizard.option2: খ) Gold is costlier than most other metals.
English Wizard.option3: গ) Gold is costliest than most other metals.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Gold is the most costlier than most other metals.
English Wizard.exp:
Very few যুক্ত Positive Degree কে Comparative Degree-তে পরিণত করার নিয়ম:-
Structure: প্রদত্ত Sentence-এর শেষের Subject + Verb + Positive Degree এর Comparative form + than most other + very few-এর পর থেকে verb-এর পূর্ব পর্যন্ত অংশ।
Example :
Positive: Very few metals are as costly as gold.
Comp: Gold is costlier than most other metals.

English Wizard.question: ৪) You must do the work. (Change the Voice)
English Wizard.option1: ক) The work should be done by you.
English Wizard.option2: খ) The work must be done by you.
English Wizard.option3: গ) The work may be done by you.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) The work might be done by you.
English Wizard.exp:
May, might, can, could, must, ought to, going to যুক্ত Active Voice কে Passive Voice এ পরিবর্তন করার সময় এদের পরে be বসে এবং তার পরেই মূল verb টির Past Participle বসে। যেমনঃ
Active: You must do the work.
Passive: The work must be done by you.

English Wizard.question: ৫) The writer took a cabin that was small. (Make it Compound)
English Wizard.option1: ক) The writer took a cabin but it was small.
English Wizard.option2: খ) The writer took a cabin and it was small.
English Wizard.option3: গ) The writer had taken a cabin and it was small.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) The writer have taken a cabin and it was small.
English Wizard.exp:
Relative pronoun যুক্ত Complex sentence কে compound করার নিয়মঃ-
Relative Pronoun টির জায়গায় and বসে এবং প্রথম sentence এর object টি Subject হিসাবে বসে। আর সব ঠিক থাকে।
(i) Complex: The writer took a cabin that was small.
Compound: The writer took a cabin and it was small.

English Wizard.question: ৬) Iron is one of the most useful metals. (Make it Positive)
English Wizard.option1: ক) Very few metals is so useful as iron
English Wizard.option2: খ) Very few metals are so useful as iron.
English Wizard.option3: গ) No other metals are so useful as iron.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) No other metals are as useful as iron
English Wizard.exp:
One of the যুক্ত Superlative Degree কে Positive Degree তে রূপান্তরের নিয়মঃ
(i) প্রথমে very few বসে + (ii) superlative degree এর পরের অংশ বসে + (iii) verb এর plural form বসে + (iv) so বসে + (vi) Superlative degree এর positive from বসে + (v) as বসে + (vii) প্রদত্ত sentence এর Subject বসে।
Structure:- Very few + superlative degree এর পরের অংশ + verb এর plural form + so + superlative degree এর positive form + as + প্রদত্ত sentence এর subject.
Super: Iron is one of the most useful metals.
Positive: Very few metals are so useful as iron.

English Wizard.question: ৮) Because of my illness, I could not join the meeting. (Make it Complex)
English Wizard.option1: ক) Although I was ill, I could not join the meeting.
English Wizard.option2: খ) Since I was ill, I could not join the meeting.
English Wizard.option3: গ) I was ill, I could not join the meeting.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Though I was ill, I could not join the meeting.
English Wizard.exp:
Because of যুক্ত Simple Sentence কে Complex-এ পরিবর্তনের নিয়মঃ
প্রথমে Since বসে + Subject বসে + Verb বসে + Adjective /Noun বসে+ Comma বসে + অপর বাক্যটি বসে।
(i) Simple: Because of my illness, I could not join the meeting.
Complex: Since I was ill, I could not join the meeting.

English Wizard.question: ১০) Never tell a lie. (Change the Voice)
English Wizard.option1: ক) Let never a lie be told.
English Wizard.option2: খ) Let a lie be told.
English Wizard.option3: গ) Let a lie be told always.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Let the lie be told.

Never যুক্ত Imperative Sentence কে Passive করার নিয়ম:
(i) প্রথমে Let never বসে+ (ii) Object টি Subject হয় + (iii) be বসে + (iv) মূল Verb এর Past Participle বসে।
যেমনঃ- :-
Active:-Never tell a lie
Passive:-Let never a lie be told

English Wizard.question: ১২) Very few boys in the village are as small as Sohel. (Make it Superlative)
English Wizard.option1: ক) Sohel is one of the smallest boys in the village.
English Wizard.option2: খ) Sohel is the smallest boys in the village.
English Wizard.option3: গ) Sohel is as smaller as all other boys in the village.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Sohel is one of the most smallest boys in the village.
English Wizard.exp:
Very few যুক্ত Positive Degree কে Superlative Degree তে পরিবর্তন করার নিয়মঃ
Structure: প্রদত্ত Sentence এর শেষের Subject + Verb+ one of the + Positive Degree এর Superlative form + very few এর পর থেকে verb এর পূর্ব পর্যন্ত অংশ।
Positive: Very few boys in the village are as small as Sohel.
Super: Sohel is one of the smallest boys in the village.

English Wizard.question: ১৩) He is as tall as his brother. (Make it Comparative)
English Wizard.option1: ক) His brother is not taller than him.
English Wizard.option2: খ) His brother is not taller than he.
English Wizard.option3: গ) His brother is not tallest than he.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) His brother is not tall than he.
English Wizard.exp:
As........ as যুক্ত Positive Degree-কে Comparative Degree- তে রূপান্তরিত করার নিয়ম:-
Structure : শেষের Subject + verb + not + Positive Degree--এর Comparative form + than + প্রদত্ত Sentence-এর প্রথম Subject.
Example:
Positive: He is as tall as his brother.
Comp: His brother is not taller than he.

English Wizard.question: ১৪) The teacher will be teaching us. (Change the Voice)
English Wizard.option1: ক) We shall be being taught by the teacher.
English Wizard.option2: খ) We might be being taught by the teacher.
English Wizard.option3: গ) We be being taught by the teacher.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) We may be being taught by the teacher.
English Wizard.exp:
Future Continuous Tense যুক্ত Active Voice কে Passive Voice -এ পরিবর্তন করার নিয়ম-
Structure: Object টির Subjective form + shall be being/ will be being + মূল Verb এর Past Participle + by + subject টির objective form.
Active: The teacher will be teaching us.
Passive: We shall be being taught by the teacher.

English Wizard.question: ১৫) Choose the synonym of “Mellifluous”.

English Wizard.option2: খ) Soothing
English Wizard.option3: গ) Dissonance
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Ominous
English Wizard.exp:
Mellifluous : (of a sound) pleasingly smooth and musical to hear.

Synonyms
sweet-sounding, sweet-toned, dulcet, honeyed, mellow, soft, liquid, soothing, rich, smooth, euphonious, lyric, harmonious, tuneful, musical
Source: Oxford

English Wizard.question: ১৬) The cow is more useful than most other animals. (Make it Positive)
English Wizard.option1: ক) Very few animals is so useful as the cow.
English Wizard.option2: খ) Very few animals are so useful as the cow.
English Wizard.option3: গ) Very few animals was so useful as the cow.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) No other animals is so useful as the cow.
English Wizard.exp:
Than most other/than few other যুক্ত Comparative Degree কে Positive Degree তে রূপান্তর করার নিয়মঃ
(i) প্রথমে Very few বসে + (ii) few other/most other এর পরের অংশ বসে + (iii) verb এর Plural বসে+ (iv) so বসে + (v) Comparative degree এর Positive form বসে + (vi) as বসে (vii) প্রদত্ত
sentence এর subject বসে।
Structure : very few + most other/ few other এর পরের অংশ + verb এর plural form + so + Comparative এর positive form + as + প্রদত্ত sentence এর subject.
(i) Comp: The cow is more useful than most other animals.
Positive: Very few animals are so useful as the cow.

English Wizard.question: ১৭) He will have read the book. (Change the Voice)
English Wizard.option1: ক) The book will have been read by him.
English Wizard.option2: খ) The book would have been read by him.
English Wizard.option3: গ) The book will have been read by he.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) The book will has been read by him.
English Wizard.exp:
Future Perfect Tense যুক্ত Active voice কে passive voice -এ পরিবর্তন করার নিয়ম-
Structure:- Object টির Subjective form + shall have been/ will have been+ মূল Verb এর Past Participle + by + Subject টির Objective form :-
Active : He will have read the book.
Passive: The book will have been read by him.

English Wizard.option2: খ) Fortify
English Wizard.option3: গ) Fret
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Virility

Synonyms for jeopardize

endanger, gamble (with), hazard, imperil, menace, peril, risk, venture
Source: Merriam-Webster

English Wizard.question: ১৯) Having forgotten him, I went out. (Make it Compound)
English Wizard.option1: ক) I have forgotten him and went out.
English Wizard.option2: খ) I had forgotten him and went out.
English Wizard.option3: গ) I forgotten him and went out.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) I had forgotten him but went out.
English Wizard.exp:
Perfect Participle যুক্ত Simple Sentence কে Compound Sentence এ পরিবর্তনের নিয়মঃ
Subject বসে + Perfect Participle এর Past Perfect form বসে + and বসে + বাকী অংশ বসে ।
(i) Simple: Having forgotten him, I went out.
Compound: I had forgotten him and went out.
সমাধানঃ Perfect Participle কে Past Perfect tense এ গঠন করা হয়েছে অর্থাৎ I had forgotten him বসানাে হয়েছে + বাকী অংশ I went out বসানাে হয়েছে।

English Wizard.question: ২০) Dhaka is bigger than most other cities in Bangladesh. (Make it Superlative)
English Wizard.option1: ক) Dhaka is the biggest cities in Bangladesh.
English Wizard.option2: খ) Dhaka is one of the biggest cities in Bangladesh.
English Wizard.option3: গ) Dhaka is the bigger cities in Bangladesh.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Dhaka is as big as any other cities in Bangladesh.
English Wizard.exp:
Than most other/ than few other যুক্ত Comparative Degree কে Superlative Degree তে রূপান্তরের নিয়মঃ
Structure:- Subject + Verb + one of the + Comparative Degree-এর Superlative form + most other/ few other এর পরের অংশ।
Comp: Dhaka is bigger than most other cities in Bangladesh.
Super: Dhaka is one of the + biggest + cities in Bangladesh.
সমাধানঃ প্রদত্ত Sentence টির Subject ও Verb বসানাে হয়েছে। নিয়ম অনুযায়ী one of the বসানাে হয়েছে + bigger এর Superlative form ''biggest'' বসানাে হয়ােছ + most other এর পরের অংশ ''cities in Bangladesh'' বসানো হয়েছে৷

English Wizard.question: ২১) Choose the synonym of “Nexus”.
English Wizard.option1: ক) Modest
English Wizard.option2: খ) Savor
English Wizard.option3: গ) Junction
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Languid
English Wizard.exp:

Synonyms
join, junction, juncture, intersection, link, linkage, connection.
Source: Oxford

English Wizard.question: ২২) The marriage ceremony was over and the guests were all going to the feast. (Make it Simple)
English Wizard.option1: ক) The marriage ceremony was over, the guests were all going to the feast.
English Wizard.option2: খ) The marriage ceremony was being over, the guests were all going to the feast.
English Wizard.option3: গ) The marriage ceremony being over, the guests were all going to the feast.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) The marriage ceremony were over, the guests were all going to the feast.
English Wizard.exp:
Compound:- The marriage ceremony was over and the guests were all going to the feast.
Simple:- The marriage ceremony being over, the guests were all going to the feast.
সমাধানঃ প্রদত্ত Sentence টির clause দুটির Subject ভিন্ন এবং প্রথম clause টিতে শুধুমাত্র be verb ''as'' বসেছে, তাই নিয়ম অনুযায়ী প্রথম clause এর be verb ''was'' এর জায়গায় being বসানাে হয়েছে। তাছাড়া প্রথম clause এর আর কোন পরিবর্তন হয়নি + and এর জায়গায় comma বসানাে হয়েছে + দ্বিতীয় clause টি অর্থাৎ the guests were all going to the feast বসানাে হয়েছে ।

English Wizard.question: ২৩) The man was poor and could not taste the food. (Make it Complex)
English Wizard.option1: ক) Since the man was poor, he could not taste the food.
English Wizard.option2: খ) The man was poor, he could not taste the food.
English Wizard.option3: গ) The man who was poor, he could not taste the food.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Because of poverty, he could not taste the food.
English Wizard.exp:
And যুক্ত Compound Sentence এর একটি clause যদি অন্যটির কারণ বা সময় নির্দেশ করে, তবে উক্ত compound Sentence টিকে complex sentence এ পরিবর্তন করতে হলে নীচের নিয়মটি অনুসরণ করতে হয়-
প্রথম Sentence-এর প্রথমে since/as/when বসে + প্রথম sentence বসে + and এর পরিবর্তে comma (,) কমা বসে + দ্বিতীয় Sentence বসে।
বিঃ দ্রঃ- কারণ বুঝালে since /as বসে এবং সময় বুঝালে when বসে।
Complex Sentence এর দুটি Clause-এ Subject বসাতে হয়।
Compound: The man was poor and could not taste the food.
Complex: Since the man was poor, he could not taste the food.

English Wizard.question: ২৪) Choose the antonym of “Lackluster”.

English Wizard.option2: খ) Lightless
English Wizard.option3: গ) Obscure
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Radiant

black, caliginous, dark, darkened, darkish, darkling, darksome, dim, dimmed, dusk, dusky, gloomy, lightless, murky, obscure, beclouded, befogged, clouded, foggy, fuliginous, misty, smoggy, soupy

Antonyms & Near Antonyms for lackluster

ablaze, agleam, aglitter, alight, beaming, beamy, effulgent, glaring, glowing, incandescent, lambent, radiant, relucent, resplendent, shining, sparkling

English Wizard.question: ২৫) Fahim is one of the tallest boys in the class. (Make it Comparative)
English Wizard.option1: ক) Fahim is taller than any other boys in the class.
English Wizard.option2: খ) Fahim is taller than most other boys in the class.
English Wizard.option3: গ) Fahim is tallest than most other boys in the class.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Fahim is tallest than any other boys in the class
English Wizard.exp:
One of the যুক্ত Superlative Degree কে Comparative Degree তে রূপান্তর করার নিয়ম:-
(i) প্রদত্ত Sentence- এর Subject ও Verb বসে + (i) One of the উঠে যায় + (iii) Superlative Degree-এর Comparative form বসে + (iv) than most other বসে + (v) প্রদত্ত Sentence- এর বাকী অংশ বসে।
Structure :- Subject + Verb + Superlative Degree এর Comparative form + than most other + প্রদত্ত Sentence এর বাকী অংশ।
Super: Fahim is one of the tallest boys in the class.
Comp: Fahim is taller than most other boys in the class.
